annotations.title: Price for a target profit on Etsy

description: Works out the item price at which one Etsy order keeps a target profit after Etsy's fees (listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 processing), the average Offsite Ads fee, Etsy Ads spread over orders, materials, packaging and the label. The target is dollars per order or a share of the order; with neither, it returns the break-even price. It fits a seller who asks what to charge, how to price for a profit, or what their break-even price is on Etsy. Takes materials, label cost, shipping charged and the shop's Offsite Ads rate (12-percent, 15-percent or off); packaging, the Offsite share, ad spend with orders, and targetProfitPerOrder or targetMargin are optional. Returns the price, the order at that price line by line, the break-even price and what each extra dollar keeps. US dollars; dated Etsy rules with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

adsMonthlySpend.description: Optional: Etsy Ads spend a month, US dollars, spread over orders. Needs orders.

materials.description: Materials and supplies per item, US dollars.

offsiteAds.description: The shop's Offsite Ads rate: 12-percent (past $10,000 in any 12 months), 15-percent (under $10,000, on), or off. none is taken as off.

offsiteShare.description: Share of sales from Offsite Ads: a fraction, or a band. Left out: 10%, the figure Etsy gave at launch in 2020, flagged as a default.

orders.description: Orders a month. Needed only with adsMonthlySpend.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping, US dollars (0 if free).

targetMargin.description: The profit one order should keep as a share of the order (item + shipping), such as 0.25. Or send targetProfitPerOrder.

targetProfitPerOrder.description: The profit one order should keep after every cost, US dollars. Or send targetMargin. Neither: the break-even price.

name: sellerprofit_price_for_margin

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

atThatPrice.description: One order at that price, as the engine works it out (costs as positive dollars). Kept can differ from the target by a cent: Etsy rounds each fee.

breakEvenItemPrice.description: The item price at which an order keeps $0.

itemPrice.description: The item price to charge, US dollars, before shipping.

keptPerExtraDollar.description: Of each extra dollar the buyer pays, what the seller keeps after Etsy's percentage fees and the average Offsite fee.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which figures are estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest depend on the size and stock Amazon measures). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.
